note: Re-judged 2026-10-27 by an independent auditor who authored none of the change, after c7d2faf055 (spec-add-path-limit-send-receive). RFC 8654 Section 5: "A BGP speaker that has the ability to use BGP Extended Messages but has not advertised the BGP Extended Message Capability, presumably due to configuration, MUST NOT accept a BGP Extended Message." STALE because negotiateWith gained one call, s.initPathsLimitRecv(s.negotiated.Encoding), after initPathsLimit: it builds the PATHS-LIMIT receive admission and touches no message-length state. The Extended Message handling and the per-direction receive limit are unchanged, capability.Negotiate is unchanged, and every tagged carrier is byte-identical, so the earlier judgement stands: the receive limit follows the local OPEN, and a message over 4096 octets is refused when the local side did not advertise the capability. Verdict unchanged: enforced.
